We value your privacy

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized ads or content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking "Accept All," you consent to our use of cookies.

Customise Consent Preferences

We use cookies to help you navigate efficiently and perform certain functions. You can find detailed information about all cookies under each consent category below.

Cookies categorized as "Necessary" are stored on your browser because they are essential for enabling the basic functionalities of the site.... 

Always Active

Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

  • Cookie
    aec
  • Duration
    6 months
  • Description

    The AEC cookie is a security cookie used by Google to help prevent Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks. It contains a random string of characters and is used to verify that requests coming to Google's servers are legitimate and originate from the expected source.

  • Cookie
    apisid
  • Duration
    2 years
  • Description

    The APISID cookie is a Google security cookie used for authentication and user security purposes.  It plays a role in preventing unauthorized access attempts and fraudulent use of Google APIs.

  • Cookie
    hsid
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The HSID (Host Security ID) cookie is one of Google's security cookies that works to authenticate users and protect against fraudulent use of login credentials.

  • Cookie
    sapisid
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The SAPISID cookie is a Google security cookie that works alongside other authentication cookies. It helps to authenticate users and maintains their security when using Google services.

  • Cookie
    sid
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The SID cookie is one of Google's core security and authentication cookies.  It's a primary authentication cookie that stores a user's signed and encrypted Google Account ID.  It helps protect against unauthorized access and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks.

  • Cookie
    sidcc
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The SIDCC  is a Google security cookie that helps protect user data from unauthorized access.  It provides protection against forgery and tracks the number of times a SID (Security ID) cookie has been used.  It's used to detect and prevent potential security attacks like replay attacks.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-1PAPISID
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The __Secure-1PAPISID cookie is a Google security and authentication cookie.  It's a secure version of the APISID cookie and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps authenticate users and protect against unauthorized access.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-1PSID
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The __Secure-1PSID cookie is a Google security cookie with enhanced security requirements.  It's a secure SID cookie version and only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps protect against unauthorized access and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-1PSIDCC
  • Duration
    1 Year
  • Description

    The __Secure-1PSIDCC cookie is a Google security cookie that is an enhanced version of the SIDCC cookie. It's a secure version of the SIDCC cookie and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps track the usage of security cookies and protects against replay attacks by tracking the number of times security cookies have been used.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-1PSIDTS
  • Duration
    1 Year
  • Description

    The __Secure-1PSIDTS cookie is a Google security cookie used for timing and session management. It is only transmitted over HTTPS and is used with other Google cookies to maintain secure sessions.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-3PAPISID
  • Duration
    1 Year
  • Description

    The __Secure-3PAPISID cookie is a Google security cookie with enhanced security requirements.  It's a secure version of the APISID cookie and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps authenticate users and protect against unauthorized access.

  • Cookie
    __Secure-3PSID
  • Duration
    1 Years
  • Description

    The __Secure-3PSID cookie is a Google security cookie with enhanced security requirements. It's a secure version of the SID cookie and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps protect against unauthorized access and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks

  • Cookie
    __Secure-3PSIDCC
  • Duration
    1 Year
  • Description

    The __Secure-3PSIDCC cookie is a Google security cookie that is an enhanced version of the SIDCC cookie. Here are the key details:

    • It's a secure version of the SIDCC cookie and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps track the usage of security cookies and protect against replay attacks by counting the number of times security cookies have been used.
  • Cookie
    __Secure-3PSIDTS
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The __Secure-3PSIDTS cookie is a Google security cookie used for timing and session management. It's a security cookie that includes timestamp information and is only transmitted over HTTPS.  It helps protect against session replay attacks and other security threats.

  • Cookie
    cfz_*
  • Duration
    session - 1 year
  • Description

    Cloudflare cfz_ cookies are security tokens used for DDoS protection and defense against malicious bots. Their main purposes are:

    1. Rate limiting and request validation - They help track and control the number of requests coming from a specific visitor
    2. Browser verification - They confirm that requests are coming from a legitimate web browser rather than an automated script or bot
    3. Session persistence - They maintain security checks across multiple pages/requests without requiring re-verification.
  • Cookie
    cookieyes-consent
  • Duration
    1 year
  • Description

    The cookieyes-consent cookie is set by CookieYes (our cookie consent management provider) and contains:

    • User's consent preferences for different cookie categories
    • Timestamp of when consent was given
    • Version of the consent
    • Usually stored in JSON format
    • Typically has a duration of 1 year
    • Essential for maintaining user's cookie preferences across sessions
    • Used to remember and honor visitor's cookie consent choices

Frequently asked questions

How do I create a digital business card?

Creating your Blinq digital business card takes less than a minute. Start by creating your card, or by downloading the app (iOS/Android). You'll be guided through the card creation process, where you can add your contact details, a profile photo, and customize your card with your company logo. Once done, you'll be ready to start sharing straight away.

Is Blinq free to use?

Yes! Blinq is free for everyone. You’ll get access to digital business cards, virtual backgrounds, and dynamic email signatures. With Blinq Premium, you unlock added customization and export options, which are free to trial for 7 days.

How do I share my Blinq card with someone who doesn't have the app?

If the recipient doesn’t have the Blinq app, your card will open in their web browser. They can easily save your details and share theirs back with you, making it easy and convenient to reconnect.

How do I share a digital business card?

Sharing your digital business card is super simple. You can have recipients scan the QR code from your Blinq app, or share it via text, email, Widgets, Apple Wallet, or even from your Apple Watch. It’s instant and convenient—perfect for sharing in person or online.

What’s the difference between a digital business card and a traditional business card?

A Blinq digital business card is like a traditional business card, but made for modern networking! No more printing costs, cards getting lost, or outdated details. It’s always on your phone, ready to share, and  can capture the details of the person you're meeting making it easy to follow-up—plus, it’s eco-friendly and completely customizable to match your business.

‍

What are the benefits of using a digital business card?

Share your contact details easily: A digital business card is the quickest and easiest way to share your professional identity.
‍
‍Your card is always with you: Whether you prefer to share using the app, from your Apple Wallet, your smart watch or home screen widgets, it will be with you wherever you and your device goes, no need to carry paper cards anymore.
‍
‍Works every time: Those who receive your card don’t need the Blinq app to get your contact details.
‍
‍Always stay up-to-date: If you change your contact information on your QR code business card, those who have your card will see your updated information.

‍

How do I get Blinq for my team or business?

Setting up Blinq for your team is easy. With Blinq Business, you can manage multiple cards, customize them with your branding, and sync your team's contacts directly with your CRM. Check out our Blinq Business subscription for more details.

‍

How much does a digital business card cost?

You can create your own Blinq digital business card for free! Start by downloading our top rated iOS app or Android app, or get started using our web dashboard.
‍
Our onboarding process will guide you through the setup process including how to customize your card with logos, profile images, colours and more. You’ll then be ready to share your digital business card in seconds!
‍
You can also sign up for Blinq Premium to create more cards for yourself or for Blinq Business if you’re looking to create cards for your wider business team. For full pricing information view our Pricing Page.

‍

How do NFC business cards work?

Blinq offers NFC or ‘Near Fields Communication’ business cards for you and your team. NFC cards have a chip embedded in each card that can be synced with your Blinq digital business card.
‍
When you want to share your details, simply tap the card on the user's compatible smartphone which will bring up a link containing your Blinq card, it really is like magic. You can purchase NFC cards via our app or our website today. Alternatively, if you already have an NFC card made by another company, you can encode it with your Blinq card by encoding your Blinq card link onto it.

How does Blinq integrate with my existing tech stack?

Blinq Business has several integrations with tools your team already uses, like HubSpot, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and more. An example of how this plays out for teams: you can sync your contacts as leads directly into your CRM, automatically provision your team's cards using Microsoft Entra, and remotely manage dynamic email signatures using Google Workspace.

What are dynamic email signatures, and how do I create one with Blinq?

Dynamic email signatures let you extend your brand with every email you send. With Blinq, you can create professional, branded signatures that match your digital business card in just a few clicks.

What are virtual backgrounds, and how can I use them with Blinq?

Blinq’s virtual backgrounds let you add a professional touch to your video calls with a branded QR code embedded directly into your custom background. Simply choose one of our backgrounds or upload your own and showcase your brand during virtual meetings.

For contacts that stay in contact

Use Blinq to capture crucial detail, spot opportunities, and turn a good meeting into brilliant business.
